description.zh: 二维码编码。您在创建消息二维码时调用[CreatePhoneMessageQrdl](~~2638749~~)接口时返回的QrdlCode，或在修改二维码时调用[UpdatePhoneMessageQrdl](~~2638746~~)接口返回的QrdlCode。
description.en: The QR code encoding. This is the QrdlCode returned by the [CreatePhoneMessageQrdl](~~2638749~~) operation when you created the message QR code, or the QrdlCode returned by the [UpdatePhoneMessageQrdl](~~2638746~~) operation when you updated the QR code.

descriptions.zh:
- 在删除消息二维码后，用户将无法通过扫描原二维码打开对应的商家号码，请谨慎操作。

- 在调用此接口前，请确保您已有成功创建的消息二维码。

- 若您没有成功创建的消息二维码，请先调用[CreatePhoneMessageQrdl](~~2638749~~)接口创建消息二维码。

#### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为5次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- After you delete a message QR code, users can no longer open the corresponding business phone number by scanning the original QR code. Proceed with caution.

- Before calling this operation, make sure that you have a successfully created message QR code.

- If you do not have a successfully created message QR code, call the [CreatePhoneMessageQrdl](~~2638749~~) operation to create one first.

#### QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 5 calls per second. If this limit is exceeded, the API calls are throttled, which may affect your business. Call this operation as appropriate.
